chunks: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Dawud al-Abzari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The minimum of glorification (Tasbih) is three times while you are prostrating; do not rush through them."
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of times one must recite tasbih during prostration in Shia prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defines the minimum dhikr for sujud as three glorifications, while explicitly advising against haste to ensure contemplative presence (khushu). In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes the baseline for the recommended practice, where scholars often encourage reciting it more than three times for greater reward, provided the worshipper maintains focus and does not rush the physical movements of prayer.
